12 A couple applies a clockwise torque of 9.0 N m to a circular disc.
Which diagram shows this couple?
A
B
50 cm
9.0 N
20 cm
45 N
9.0 N
45 N
D
C
45 N
10 cm
9.0 N
100 cm
9.0 N
45 N

hints: Look at the two forces on each disc: they are equal, opposite and parallel, so the perpendicular separation between them is the labelled disc diameter in $\text{cm}$.

Recall that torque of a couple is $F \times d$ with $d$ in $\text{m}$, so convert $50 \text{ cm}$, $20 \text{ cm}$, $10 \text{ cm}$ and $100 \text{ cm}$ to metres before multiplying by $9.0 \text{ N}$ or $45 \text{ N}$.

Decide the sense from the top force: top to the right with bottom to the left turns the disc clockwise, while top to the left with bottom to the right turns it anticlockwise, then keep only the diagram with both $9.0 \text{ N m}$ and clockwise.
walkthrough: A couple is two equal and opposite parallel forces. Its torque magnitude is $\text{torque} = F \times d$, where $d$ is the perpendicular distance between the lines of action, here the disc diameter.
Convert diameters to metres: $50 \text{ cm} = 0.50 \text{ m}$, $20 \text{ cm} = 0.20 \text{ m}$, $10 \text{ cm} = 0.10 \text{ m}$, $100 \text{ cm} = 1.00 \text{ m}$.
Calculate magnitudes: A gives $9.0 \times 0.50 = 4.5 \text{ N m}$, B gives $45 \times 0.20 = 9.0 \text{ N m}$, C gives $45 \times 0.10 = 4.5 \text{ N m}$, D gives $9.0 \times 1.00 = 9.0 \text{ N m}$.

Check direction: with the top force to the right and bottom force to the left the disc is driven clockwise, as in A and B. With the top force to the left and bottom force to the right it is driven anticlockwise, as in C and D.
Only the diagram with $9.0 \text{ N m}$ magnitude and clockwise sense satisfies both conditions. This is option B.

A.explanation: The sense is clockwise but the torque is $9.0 \times 0.50 = 4.5 \text{ N m}$, only half the required $9.0 \text{ N m}$.

B.explanation: The torque is $45 \times 0.20 = 9.0 \text{ N m}$ and the top force to the right with bottom force to the left gives a clockwise turn.

C.explanation: The torque is $45 \times 0.10 = 4.5 \text{ N m}$ and the top force to the left gives an anticlockwise turn.

D.explanation: The torque magnitude is $9.0 \times 1.00 = 9.0 \text{ N m}$ but the top force to the left gives an anticlockwise turn.
